This paper explores AI governance professionals' concerns in enterprise settings, while offering design-time and runtime explainability techniques as suggested by AI governance experts for addressing those fears. Finally, we provide a preliminary prototype of an Agentic AI Card that can help companies feel at ease deploying agents at scale.
papers.title_zh: 大规模代理可解释性：在企业恐惧和 XAI 需求之间
papers.abstract_zh: 随着公司加入代理人工智能采用的竞赛，人们对代理自主及其后续风险的担忧浮出水面。随着公司通过低代码应用程序扩大代理人工智能的采用，而其治理流程和专业知识却没有相应的扩展，这些担忧变得更加复杂，从而导致了一种被称为“代理蔓延”的现象。虽然影子人工智能工具可以帮助代理发现和识别，但很少有可观察性工具可以深入了解代理的配置和设置或代理间通信和编排期间的决策过程。本文探讨了人工智能治理专业人员在企业环境中的担忧，同时提供了人工智能治理专家建议的设计时和运行时可解释性技术来解决这些担忧。最后，我们提供了 Agentic AI 卡的初步原型，可以帮助公司轻松地大规模部署代理。

papers.title: Class Unlearning via Depth-Aware Removal of Forget-Specific Directions
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model without the cost of retraining from scratch. In class unlearning, however, reducing accuracy on forget classes does not necessarily imply true forgetting: forgotten information can remain encoded in internal representations, and apparent forgetting may arise from classifier-head suppression rather than representational removal. We show that existing class-unlearning methods often exhibit weak or negative selectivity, preserve forget-class structure in deep representations, or rely heavily on final-layer bias shifts. We then introduce DAMP (Depth-Aware Modulation by Projection), a one-shot, closed-form weight-surgery method that removes forget-specific directions from a pretrained network without gradient-based optimization. At each stage, DAMP computes class prototypes in the input space of the next learnable operator, extracts forget directions as residuals relative to retain-class prototypes, and applies a projection-based update to reduce downstream sensitivity to those directions. To preserve utility, DAMP uses a parameter-free depth-aware scaling rule derived from probe separability, applying smaller edits in early layers and larger edits in deeper layers. The method naturally extends to multi-class forgetting through low-rank subspace removal. Across MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet, and across convolutional and transformer architectures, DAMP more closely resembles the retraining gold standard than some of the prior methods, improving selective forgetting while better preserving retain-class performance and reducing residual forget-class structure in deep layers.
papers.title_zh: 通过深度感知删除忘记特定方向来消除类学习
papers.abstract_zh: 机器取消学习的目的是从经过训练的模型中删除目标知识，而无需从头开始重新训练。然而，在类遗忘中，降低遗忘类的准确性并不一定意味着真正的遗忘：遗忘的信息可以在内部表示中保持编码，并且明显的遗忘可能来自分类器头抑制而不是表示删除。我们表明，现有的类遗忘方法通常表现出较弱或负面的选择性，在深度表示中保留忘记类结构，或者严重依赖最终层的偏差变化。然后，我们介绍 DAMP（投影深度感知调制），这是一种一次性的封闭式权重手术方法，可以从预训练网络中删除忘记特定的方向，而无需基于梯度的优化。在每个阶段，DAMP 计算下一个可学习运算符的输入空间中的类原型，提取遗忘方向作为相对于保留类原型的残差，并应用基于投影的更新来降低下游对这些方向的敏感度。为了保留实用性，DAMP 使用源自探针可分离性的无参数深度感知缩放规则，在早期层中应用较小的编辑，在更深的层中应用较大的编辑。该方法自然地通过低秩子空间去除扩展到多类遗忘。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 Tiny ImageNet 中，以及在卷积和 Transformer 架构中，DAMP 比之前的一些方法更类似于再训练黄金标准，改善选择性遗忘，同时更好地保留保留类性能并减少深层中的残留遗忘类结构。

papers.title: Autonomous Evolution of EDA Tools: Multi-Agent Self-Evolved ABC
papers.abstract: This paper introduces the first \emph{self-evolving} logic synthesis framework, which leverages Large Language Model (LLM) agents to autonomously improve the source code of \textsc{ABC}, the widely adopted logic synthesis system. Our framework operates on the \emph{entire integrated ABC codebase}, and the output repository preserves its single-binary execution model and command interface. In the initial evolution cycle, we bootstrap the system using existing prior open-source synthesis components, covering flow tuning, logic minimization, and technology mapping, but without manually injecting new heuristics. On top of this foundation, a team of LLM-based agents iteratively rewrites and evolves specific sub-components of ABC following our ``programming guidance`` prompts under a unified correctness and QoR-driven evaluation loop. Each evolution cycle proposes code modifications, compiles the integrated binary, validates correctness, and evaluates quality-of-results (QoR) on \emph{multi-suite benchmarks including ISCAS~85/89/99, VTR, EPFL, and IWLS~2005}. Through continuous feedback, the system discovers optimizations beyond human-designed heuristics, effectively \emph{learning new synthesis strategies} that enhance QoR. We detail the architecture of this self-improving system, its integration with \textsc{ABC}, and results demonstrating that the framework can autonomously and progressively improve EDA tool at full million-line scale.
papers.title_zh: EDA工具的自主进化：多Agent自进化ABC
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了第一个 \emph{self-evolving} 逻辑综合框架，该框架利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理来自主改进 \textsc{ABC}（广泛采用的逻辑综合系统）的源代码。我们的框架在 \emph{整个集成 ABC 代码库}上运行，输出存储库保留其单二进制执行模型和命令接口。在最初的演化周期中，我们使用现有的现有开源综合组件引导系统，涵盖流程调整、逻辑最小化和技术映射，但无需手动注入新的启发式方法。在此基础上，基于 LLM 的代理团队按照我们的“编程指南”提示，在统一的正确性和 QoR 驱动的评估循环下迭代地重写和发展 ABC 的特定子组件。每个演进周期都会提出代码修改、编译集成的二进制文件、验证正确性，并在 \emph{多套件基准包括 ISCAS~85/89/99、VTR、EPFL 和 IWLS~2005} 上评估结果质量 (QoR)。通过持续的反馈，系统发现了超出人类设计启发式的优化，有效地\emph{学习新的综合策略}来增强 QoR。我们详细介绍了这个自我改进系统的架构、它与 \textsc{ABC} 的集成，以及结果表明该框架可以在百万行规模上自主地、逐步地​​改进 EDA 工具。

papers.title: AD4AD: Benchmarking Visual Anomaly Detection Models for Safer Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: The reliability of a machine vision system for autonomous driving depends heavily on its training data distribution. When a vehicle encounters significantly different conditions, such as atypical obstacles, its perceptual capabilities can degrade substantially. Unlike many domains where errors carry limited consequences, failures in autonomous driving translate directly into physical risk for passengers, pedestrians, and other road users. To address this challenge, we explore Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) as a solution. VAD enables the identification of anomalous objects not present during training, allowing the system to alert the driver when an unfamiliar situation is detected. Crucially, VAD models produce pixel-level anomaly maps that can guide driver attention to specific regions of concern without requiring any prior assumptions about the nature or form of the hazard. We benchmark eight state-of-the-art VAD methods on AnoVox, the largest synthetic dataset for anomaly detection in autonomous driving. In particular, we evaluate performance across four backbone architectures spanning from large networks to lightweight ones such as MobileNet and DeiT-Tiny. Our results demonstrate that VAD transfers effectively to road scenes. Notably, Tiny-Dinomaly achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off for edge deployment, matching full-scale localization performance at a fraction of the memory cost. This study represents a concrete step toward safer, more responsible deployment of autonomous vehicles, ultimately improving protection for passengers, pedestrians, and all road users.
papers.title_zh: AD4AD：对视觉异常检测模型进行基准测试，以实现更安全的自动驾驶
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶机器视觉系统的可靠性在很大程度上取决于其训练数据分布。当车辆遇到明显不同的条件（例如非典型障碍物）时，其感知能力可能会大幅下降。与许多错误后果有限的领域不同，自动驾驶的失败会直接转化为乘客、行人和其他道路使用者的人身风险。为了应对这一挑战，我们探索了视觉异常检测（VAD）作为解决方案。 VAD 能够识别训练期间不存在的异常物体，从而使系统能够在检测到不熟悉的情况时向驾驶员发出警报。至关重要的是，VAD 模型生成像素级异常图，可以引导驾驶员注意特定的关注区域，而无需事先假设危险的性质或形式。我们在 AnoVox（最大的自动驾驶异常检测合成数据集）上对八种最先进的 VAD 方法进行了基准测试。特别是，我们评估了从大型网络到 MobileNet 和 DeiT-Tiny 等轻量级网络的四种主干架构的性能。我们的结果表明，VAD 可以有效地转移到道路场景。值得注意的是，Tiny-Dinomaly 实现了边缘部署的最佳精度与效率权衡，以一小部分内存成本实现了全面的本地化性能。这项研究代表了朝着更安全、更负责任地部署自动驾驶汽车迈出的具体一步，最终改善对乘客、行人和所有道路使用者的保护。

papers.title: IUQ: Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification for Long-Form Large Language Model Generation
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), uncertainty quantification in LLM generation is a persistent challenge. Although recent approaches have achieved strong performance by restricting LLMs to produce short or constrained answer sets, many real-world applications require long-form and free-form text generation. A key difficulty in this setting is that LLMs often produce responses that are semantically coherent yet factually inaccurate, while the underlying semantics are multifaceted and the linguistic structure is complex. To tackle this challenge, this paper introduces Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification (IUQ), a novel framework that leverages inter-sample consistency and intra-sample faithfulness to quantify the uncertainty in long-form LLM outputs. By utilizing an interrogate-then-respond paradigm, our method provides reliable measures of claim-level uncertainty and the model's faithfulness. Experimental results across diverse model families and model sizes demonstrate the superior performance of IUQ over two widely used long-form generation datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/louisfanhz/IUQ.
papers.title_zh: IUQ：长格式大型语言模型生成的疑问不确定性量化
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型 (LLM) 取得了快速发展，但 LLM 生成中的不确定性量化仍然是一个持续的挑战。尽管最近的方法通过限制法学硕士生成简短或受限的答案集而取得了强大的性能，但许多现实世界的应用程序需要长格式和自由格式的文本生成。这种情况下的一个关键困难是，法学硕士通常会产生语义连贯但实际上不准确的回答，而底层语义是多方面的，语言结构也很复杂。为了应对这一挑战，本文引入了疑问不确定性量化（IUQ），这是一种利用样本间一致性和样本内忠实度来量化长格式 LLM 输出中的不确定性的新颖框架。通过利用询问然后响应范式，我们的方法提供了索赔级别不确定性和模型可信度的可靠测量。不同模型系列和模型大小的实验结果证明了 IUQ 相对于两个广泛使用的长格式生成数据集的卓越性能。代码可在 https://github.com/louisfanhz/IUQ 获取。

papers.title: The Possibility of Artificial Intelligence Becoming a Subject and the Alignment Problem
papers.abstract: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is increasingly being discussed not only as a tool, but also as a potential subject with personal and therefore moral status. In our opinion, the currently dominant alignment strategies, which focus on human control and containment of AI, therefore fall short. Building on Turing's analogy of "child machines", we are developing a vision of the possibility of autonomy-supporting parenting of AI, in which human control over a developing AGI is gradually reduced, allowing AI to become an independent, autonomous subject. Rather than viewing AGI, as is currently prevalent, as a dangerous creature that needs to be locked up and controlled, we should approach potential AGI with respect for a possible developing subject on the one hand, and with full confidence in our human capabilities on the other. Such a perspective opens up the possibility of cooperative coexistence and co-evolution between humans and AGIs. The relationship between humans and AGIs will thus have to be newly determined, which will change our self-image as humans. It will be crucial that humans not only claim control over potential AGIs, but also engage with AGIs through surprise, creativity, and other specifically human qualities, thereby offering them motivating incentives for cooperation.
papers.title_zh: 人工智能成为主体的可能性与对准问题
papers.abstract_zh: 人们越来越多地讨论通用人工智能（AGI），不仅将其视为一种工具，而且将其视为具有个人地位和道德地位的潜在主题。我们认为，目前主要关注人类控制和人工智能遏制的主导策略是不够的。基于图灵对“儿童机器”的类比，我们正在开发一种支持人工智能自主养育的可能性的愿景，其中人类对正在发展的 AGI 的控制逐渐减少，从而使人工智能成为一个独立、自主的主体。我们不应该像目前流行的那样将通用人工智能视为一种需要被锁定和控制的危险生物，而应该一方面尊重可能发展的对象，另一方面对我们人类的能力充满信心来对待潜在的通用人工智能。这样的观点开启了人类与通用人工智能之间合作共存和共同进化的可能性。因此，人类和通用人工智能之间的关系必须重新确定，这将改变我们作为人类的自我形象。至关重要的是，人类不仅要控制潜在的 AGI，还要通过惊喜、创造力和其他人类特有的品质与 AGI 互动，从而为他们提供合作的激励。

papers.title: Benchmarking Classical Coverage Path Planning Heuristics on Irregular Hexagonal Grids for Maritime Coverage Scenarios
papers.abstract: Coverage path planning on irregular hexagonal grids is relevant to maritime surveillance, search and rescue and environmental monitoring, yet classical methods are often compared on small ad hoc examples or on rectangular grids. This paper presents a reproducible benchmark of deterministic single-vehicle coverage path planning heuristics on irregular hexagonal graphs derived from synthetic but maritime-motivated areas of interest. The benchmark contains 10,000 Hamiltonian-feasible instances spanning compact, elongated, and irregular morphologies, 17 heuristics from seven families, and a common evaluation protocol covering Hamiltonian success, complete-coverage success, revisits, path length, heading changes, and CPU latency. Across the released dataset, heuristics with explicit shortest-path reconnection solve the relaxed coverage task reliably but almost never produce zero-revisit tours. Exact Depth-First Search confirms that every released instance is Hamiltonian-feasible. The strongest classical Hamiltonian baseline is a Warnsdorff variant that uses an index-based tie-break together with a terminal-inclusive residual-degree policy, reaching 79.0% Hamiltonian success. The dominant design choice is not tie-breaking alone, but how the residual degree is defined when the endpoint is reserved until the final move. This shows that underreported implementation details can materially affect performance on sparse geometric graphs with bottlenecks. The benchmark is intended as a controlled testbed for heuristic analysis rather than as a claim of operational optimality at fleet scale.
papers.title_zh: 针对海上覆盖场景的不规则六边形网格的经典覆盖路径规划启发式基准测试
papers.abstract_zh: 不规则六边形网格上的覆盖路径规划与海上监视、搜救和环境监测相关，但通常在小型临时示例或矩形网格上比较经典方法。本文提出了确定性单车辆覆盖路径规划启发式的可重复基准，该基准基于从合成但受海上驱动的感兴趣区域派生的不规则六边形图。该基准包含 10,000 个哈密顿可行实例，涵盖紧凑、拉长和不规则形态，来自七个系列的 17 种启发式方法，以及涵盖哈密顿成功、完全覆盖成功、重访、路径长度、航向变化和 CPU 延迟的通用评估协议。在已发布的数据集中，具有显式最短路径重新连接的启发式方法可靠地解决了宽松的覆盖任务，但几乎从不产生零重访旅行。精确深度优先搜索确认每个发布的实例都是哈密顿可行的。最强的经典哈密顿基线是 Warnsdorff 变体，它使用基于指数的抢七局和终端包含残差度策略，达到 79.0% 的哈密顿成功率。主要的设计选择不仅仅是打破平局，而是在保留终点直到最后一步时如何定义剩余程度。这表明，未充分报告的实现细节可能会严重影响具有瓶颈的稀疏几何图的性能。该基准旨在作为启发式分析的受控测试平台，而不是作为车队规模运营优化的主张。

papers.title: Where are the Humans? A Scoping Review of Fairness in Multi-agent AI Systems
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in Generative AI are giving rise to increasingly sophisticated Multi-Agent AI (MAAI) systems. While AI fairness has been extensively studied in traditional predictive scenarios, its examination in MAAI remains nascent and fragmented. This scoping review critically synthesizes existing research on fairness in MAAI systems. Through a qualitative content analysis of 23 selected studies, we identify five archetypal approaches. Our findings reveal that fairness in MAAI systems is often addressed superficially, lacks robust normative foundations, and frequently overlooks the complex dynamics introduced by agent autonomy and system-level interactions. We argue that fairness must be embedded structurally throughout the development lifecycle of MAAI, rather than appended as a post-hoc consideration. Meaningful evaluation requires explicit human oversight, normative clarity, and a precise articulation of fairness objectives and beneficiaries. This review provides a foundation for advancing fairness research in MAAI systems by highlighting critical gaps, exposing prevailing limitations, and suggesting pathways.
papers.title_zh: 人类在哪里？多智能体人工智能系统公平性的范围审查
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的快速发展正在催生日益复杂的多智能体人工智能（MAAI）系统。虽然人工智能公平性已在传统预测场景中得到了广泛研究，但它在 MAAI 中的检验仍然处于新生阶段且支离破碎。本次范围界定审查批判性地综合了有关 MAAI 系统公平性的现有研究。通过对 23 项选定研究的定性内容分析，我们确定了五种典型方法。我们的研究结果表明，MAAI 系统中的公平性往往被肤浅地解决，缺乏稳健的规范基础，并且经常忽视由代理自主和系统级交互引入的复杂动态。我们认为，公平性必须在结构上嵌入到 MAAI 的整个开发生命周期中，而不是作为事后考虑附加。有意义的评估需要明确的人为监督、规范的清晰度以及公平目标和受益人的精确阐述。这篇综述通过强调关键差距、暴露普遍的局限性并提出路径建议，为推进 MAAI 系统的公平性研究奠定了基础。

papers.title: HyperSpace: A Generalized Framework for Spatial Encoding in Hyperdimensional Representations
papers.abstract: Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) provide a well-defined algebraic framework for compositional representations in hyperdimensional spaces. We introduce HyperSpace, an open-source framework that decomposes VSA systems into modular operators for encoding, binding, bundling, similarity, cleanup, and regression. Using HyperSpace, we analyze and benchmark two representative VSA backends: Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR) and Fourier Holographic Reduced Representations (FHRR). Although FHRR provides lower theoretical complexity for individual operations, HyperSpaces modularity reveals that similarity and cleanup dominate runtime in spatial domains. As a result, HRR and FHRR exhibit comparable end-to-end performance. Differences in memory footprint introduce additional deployment trade-offs where HRR requires approximately half the memory of FHRR vectors. By enabling modular, system-level evaluation, HyperSpace reveals practical trade-offs in VSA pipelines that are not apparent from theoretical or operator-level comparisons alone.
papers.title_zh: 超空间：超维表示空间编码的通用框架
papers.abstract_zh: 矢量符号架构 (VSA) 为超维空间中的组合表示提供了定义明确的代数框架。我们引入了 HyperSpace，这是一个开源框架，它将 VSA 系统分解为模块化运算符，用于编码、绑定、捆绑、相似性、清理和回归。使用 HyperSpace，我们对两个代表性 VSA 后端进行分析和基准测试：全息简化表示 (HRR) 和傅里叶全息简化表示 (FHRR)。尽管 FHRR 为单个操作提供了较低的理论复杂性，但 HyperSpaces 模块化表明相似性和清理在空间域中主导运行时。因此，HRR 和 FHRR 表现出相当的端到端性能。内存占用的差异会带来额外的部署权衡，其中 HRR 需要的内存大约是 FHRR 矢量的一半。通过实现模块化、系统级评估，HyperSpace 揭示了 VSA 管道中的实际权衡，而这些权衡仅从理论或操作级比较中并不明显。

papers.title: Agentic Microphysics: A Manifesto for Generative AI Safety
papers.abstract: This paper advances a methodological proposal for safety research in agentic AI. As systems acquire planning, memory, tool use, persistent identity, and sustained interaction, safety can no longer be analysed primarily at the level of the isolated model. Population-level risks arise from structured interaction among agents, through processes of communication, observation, and mutual influence that shape collective behaviour over time. As the object of analysis shifts, a methodological gap emerges. Approaches focused either on single agents or on aggregate outcomes do not identify the interaction-level mechanisms that generate collective risks or the design variables that control them. A framework is required that links local interaction structure to population-level dynamics in a causally explicit way, allowing both explanation and intervention. We introduce two linked concepts. Agentic microphysics defines the level of analysis: local interaction dynamics where one agent's output becomes another's input under specific protocol conditions. Generative safety defines the methodology: growing phenomena and elicit risks from micro-level conditions to identify sufficient mechanisms, detect thresholds, and design effective interventions.
papers.title_zh: 代理微观物理：生成人工智能安全宣言
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了代理人工智能安全研究的方法论建议。随着系统获得规划、记忆、工具使用、持久身份和持续交互，安全性不再主要在孤立模型的层面上进行分析。群体层面的风险源于主体之间的结构化互动，通过沟通、观察和相互影响的过程，随着时间的推移塑造集体行为。随着分析对象的转变，方法论上的差距出现了。关注单一主体或总体结果的方法并不能识别产生集体风险的交互层面机制或控制它们的设计变量。需要一个框架，以因果明确的方式将当地互动结构与人口层面的动态联系起来，从而允许解释和干预。我们引入两个相关的概念。代理微观物理定义了分析级别：局部交互动态，其中一个代理的输出在特定协议条件下成为另一个代理的输入。生成安全定义了方法：不断增长的现象并从微观条件引发风险，以识别足够的机制、检测阈值并设计有效的干预措施。

papers.title: Stability and Generalization in Looped Transformers
papers.abstract: Looped transformers promise test-time compute scaling by spending more iterations on harder problems, but it remains unclear which architectural choices let them extrapolate to harder problems at test time rather than memorize training-specific solutions. We introduce a fixed-point based framework for analyzing looped architectures along three axes of stability -- reachability, input-dependence, and geometry -- and use it to characterize when fixed-point iteration yields meaningful predictions. Theoretically, we prove that looped networks without recall have countable fixed points and cannot achieve strong input-dependence at any spectral regime, while recall combined with outer normalization reliably produces a regime in which fixed points are simultaneously reachable, locally smooth in the input, and supported by stable backpropagation. Empirically, we train single-layer looped transformers on chess, sudoku, and prefix-sums and find that downstream performance tracks the framework's predictions across tasks and architectural configurations. We additionally introduce internal recall, a novel recall placement variant, and show that it becomes competitive with -- and on sudoku, substantially better than -- standard recall placement once outer normalization is applied.
papers.title_zh: 环形变压器的稳定性和泛化
papers.abstract_zh: 循环变压器通过在更难的问题上花费更多的迭代来承诺测试时的计算扩展，但目前还不清楚哪种架构选择可以让它们在测试时推断更难的问题，而不是记住特定于训练的解决方案。我们引入了一个基于定点的框架，用于沿着三个稳定性轴（可达性、输入依赖性和几何形状）分析循环架构，并使用它来表征定点迭代何时产生有意义的预测。从理论上讲，我们证明，没有召回率的循环网络具有可数的固定点，并且无法在任何频谱范围内实现强输入依赖性，而召回率与外部归一化相结合可靠地产生了一个固定点同时可达、输入局部平滑并得到稳定反向传播支持的范围。根据经验，我们在国际象棋、数独和前缀和上训练单层循环变压器，发现下游性能跟踪框架跨任务和架构配置的预测。我们还引入了内部回忆，这是一种新颖的回忆放置变体，并表明，一旦应用外部标准化，它就会与标准回忆放置相比，并且在数独上明显优于标准回忆放置。
